Published terms: Book in advance at participating locations. A drop charge or mileage charge may apply in addition to the rate. Same-city returns can also have a charge or higher rate; an applicable drop charge is disclosed during online booking and payable at pickup.
What is not established: A return location in the same city does not establish that the rate or drop charge is unchanged.

Published terms: Possible one-way charges are assessed case by case. Listed factors include distance, rental duration, vehicle type and return location.
What is not established: A national one-way page is not a fixed fee quote or confirmation that the chosen car is available for this route and renter.

Published terms: Most locations are described as not charging a separate drop-off or one-way fee; pricing varies by location. The page directs renters to review fees in step three of reservation and describes a confirmation email after a return-location modification.
What is not established: No separate one-way fee does not establish that the whole rental costs the same as a same-location return.
